name: Separately excited DC motor
summary: A separately excited DC motor has a documented field circuit supplied separately from the armature circuit.
description: A separately excited DC motor has a documented field circuit supplied separately from the armature circuit. The schematic must show both supplies and their relevant controls.
readingNotes: Trace the field source independently from armature power.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Separately excited and series-excited motors do not share the same field-current path.
